mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months signals a shift to monetary easing, lowering discount rates and increasing present-value weights on future cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a risk-off reaction, compressing discount rates and reducing the present value of expected equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in rate-hike periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment benefits claims (PAYEMS) above 150,000 signals labor market weakness, reducing investor confidence and compressing discount rates, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in high-PAYEMS periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment benefits claims (PAYEMS) below 100,000 signals strengthening labor market conditions, boosting investor confidence and discount rate compression, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in low-PAYEMS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105 indicates weakening domestic demand, compressing discount rates and reducing the present value of expected equity cash flows, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in low-INDPRO periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above 110 signals a rebound in domestic demand, compressing discount rates and boosting the present value of expected equity cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in high-INDPRO periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) below 250 indicates easing supply-side pressures, compressing discount rates and reducing the present value of expected equity cash flows, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in low-CPIAUCSL periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 260 signals supply-side pressures, compressing discount rates and reducing the present value of expected equity cash flows, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in high-CPIAUCSL periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
